trap.label: put on × wear
trap.wrong: I put a blue jacket every day.
trap.right: I wear a blue jacket every day.
trap.why: O brasileiro traduz "vestir/pôr" por put; put on é o ato de vestir, wear é usar.

fix.wrong: She puts a hat every day.
fix.right: She wears a hat every day.

rewrite.prompt: Use put on: “I wear my coat now.” (ação)
Use put: “Place the keys on the desk.”
rewrite.answer: Put the keys on the desk.
